author: Gamersworld
quote: The controls are completely outdated, and you fight the clunky camera more than the bosses. The massive game world often feels empty and barren, and the constant instrument playing drags down an already sluggish pace even further. It's a vastly overrated nostalgia trip that just doesn't hold up today.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
